title: Gratitude Journal Themes
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`prayer:session`), scripture readings (`scripture:reading`), fasting logs (`fasting:log`), gratitude entries (`gratitude:entry`), retreats (`retreat:event`).
app: Spiritual-practice and mindfulness logs — prayer / meditation timers, scripture-reading plans (YouVersion), fasting and gratitude journals, and retreat calendars — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=gratitude:entry
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as entries, values(theme) as themes by _time
| sort - _time
description: Summarises what you have been grateful for each month, surfacing the recurring themes in your life.
value: Noticing what consistently brings gratitude helps you invest more in the people and things that matter.
implementation: Ingest gratitude entries into `index=personal`; summarise themes per month.
visualization: Table of gratitude themes by month.

references.title: Greater Good Science Center — gratitude research

grandmaExplanation: It gathers up what you have been thankful for each month, showing what really brings you joy.
